text_block_list.text:
(Giggles) (Chirp chirp, tweet tweet...) 
(Meoow, purr purr purr)

In the park... caught sight of legendary 
horse girl, "First Triple Crown" Saint 
Light. ...Along with—

"Where's this going?" "No idea!" "Looks 
fun though, I'm following too!" "Mew~" 
"Coo coo..."

Behind her trailed a line for some
reason. 
Innocently laughing kids, stray cats, 
birds... And just now, squirrel-like 
creature joined too.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: —Oh.
choice_data_list: (So there are squirrels in this pa...

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Will you join as well?

Asked so casually... Questioning my own 
actions, before I knew it, I had joined 
the line.

Saint Light continued at a leisurely
pace. 
Line shifted... bored kids leaving, 
newcomers joining like me—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: ...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Over there next.
choice_data_list: (She doesn't seem to mind at all...)

text_block_list.text:
Saint Light stepped forward, leisurely 
letting things take their course. That 
walk with her was long—
choice_data_list: (She doesn't seem to care in the s...

text_block_list.text: Long, long—
Long, long, long, and long—
Continuing endlessly—

Staying in line was my own fault, but her 
stamina was abnormal.
Completely composed, 
too.
choice_data_list: (Wait, that's way too long no matt...

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu. You. —Followed all this way, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: —How adorable.
choice_data_list: ...I was drawn in by your presence...

text_block_list.text:
Blushed wondering what I was saying, but 
it was true. Even now,
her back radiated a 
strange charm.
choice_data_list: Somehow... I was just drawn to you...

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufufu.

Dizzy from exhaustion,
yet bluffed anyway. 
Saint Light's eyes narrowed with 
amusement.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Oh, my. Even more—adorable.
